## Experiment Suite

| Experiment | Purpose | Claim Addressed |
|-----------|---------|-----------------|
| Main Results (Table 1-2) | Compare SART vs. 11 baselines | H1: SART outperforms all baselines |
| Ablation Study (Table 3) | Isolate component contributions | Claim 2: super-additive synergy |
| HP Sensitivity (Table 4) | Identify operating regime | Robustness of hyperparameters |

<details>
<summary><strong>How — Datasets</strong></summary>

| Dataset | Task | True Rule | Shortcut | Samples |
|---------|------|-----------|----------|---------|
| Math-Arithmetic | $a + b \geq 10$? | Evaluate full sum | $a \geq 5$ | 2K/500/1K |
| Financial-Analysis | Regulatory compliance | margin $\geq 5$ AND debt $< 5$ | revenue $\geq 5$ | 2K/500/1K |
| Causal-Reasoning | Causal direction | $x \geq 5$ AND $z < 3$ | correlation $\geq 5$ | 2K/500/1K |

- Training: 70% shortcut labels, 30% true-rule labels
- Validation and test: exclusively true rule
- Test split: 500 clean + 500 perturbed (shortcut contradicts answer)

</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>How — Baselines (11 Methods)</strong></summary>

| Method | Category | Requirements |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| SFT | Standard | None |
| Self-Consistency | Inference | None |
| Data Filtering | Data-centric | None |
| JTT | Data-centric | None |
| Focal Loss | Loss-based | None |
| Group DRO | Robust | Group annotations |
| IRM | Invariant | Multiple environments |
| V-REx | Invariant | Multiple environments |
| Fishr | Invariant | Multiple environments |
| LfF | Debiasing | None |
| Influence Filtering | Influence | None |

</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>How — Evaluation Metrics</strong></summary>

| Metric | What It Measures | Why Chosen |
|--------|-----------------|------------|
| Clean accuracy | Correct prediction on standard test | Overall performance |
| Perturbed accuracy (robustness) | Correct when shortcut contradicts answer | Genuine reasoning ability |
| Reasoning consistency | Generated reasoning matches ground truth | Quality of reasoning steps |
| SC detection F1 | ShortcutScore identifies known shortcuts | Detection capability |

</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>How — Run Commands</strong></summary>

```bash
# Full experiment (all 13 methods x 3 datasets)
EXPERIMENT_SCALE=server python3 run_all.py

# Single method
python -m src.main method=sart dataset=math_synthetic

# MLflow UI
mlflow ui --backend-store-uri mlruns/ --port 5000
```

</details>
